title: Use these 4 AI Plugins to stop your AI from creating generic AI Slop content
description:
If you're tired of your AI constantly producing the same generic AI slop, use these 4 free plugins to fix it.

First use Impeccable for design.

It gives Claude real design taste pulled from premium references.

Your UI stops looking vibe coded.

And then combine it with 21st Dev MCP.

You get access to over 10,000 professional UI components and templates for apps and websites.

Then use Humanizer for writing.

It removes all 33 tell tale signs of AI writing.

It also studies your writing style so everything it outputs sounds exactly like you.

And finally Claude Code Setup for coding.

It's an official Anthropic plugin.

It scans your entire codebase and sets up the best hooks, skills, MCPs, and sub-agents your project needs.

So you start with a perfect setup built for your project.

Instead of one with useless skills and MCPs cluttering everything up.

Together, these four cover design, components, writing, and setup, the four things that make AI output feel generic.

#claudecode #aiplugins #aislop #aihumanizer #claudeai
